test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Venus marked an article at 60% above its cost price. She sold it at a profit of 20%. Find the discount percentage offered on the article.
solution:
Given:

Marked price (MP) = 160% of Cost price (C.P.)

Profit = 20%

Formula used:

Cost price × (100 + Profit percentage)/100 = Selling price

Marked Price × (100 - Discount percentage)/100 = Selling price

Calculation:

Let the cost price be 100 and the discount percentage be D

So, Marked price = 160 and Selling price = 120

According to the Question,

160 × (100 - D)/100 = 120

⇒ (100 - D) = 3 × 100/4

⇒ 100 - D = 75

⇒ D = 25

**∴ Discount percentage = 25%**
